```javascript
import products from './products.json' with {type:'json'};

const SEARCH_TOOL = {
  name: 'inventory_search',
  description: 'Search products by name',
  inputSchema: {
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      query: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'Substring to search for in product names (case-insensitive)'
      },
      limit: {
        type: 'integer',
        minimum: 1,
        maximum: 10,
        description: 'Maximum number of results to return (1-10)'
      }
    },
    required: ['query'],
    additionalProperties: false
  }
};

export async function listTools() {
  return [SEARCH_TOOL];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'inventory_search') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }

  const { query, limit } = args;

  // Validate query
  if (typeof query !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: query must be a string');
  }
  // Some clients send empty strings; treat them as errors per required + string
  if (query.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: query must be a non-empty string');
  }

  // Validate limit
  let resultLimit;
  if (limit !== undefined) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 10) {
      throw new Error('Invalid arguments: limit must be an integer between 1 and 10');
    }
    resultLimit = limit;
  }

  const q = query.toLowerCase();
  const matches = products.filter(p => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));

  const limited = resultLimit !== undefined ? matches.slice(0, resultLimit) : matches;

  const text = limited.length === 0
    ? 'No products matched.'
    : limited.map(p => `${p.id}: ${p.name}`).join('\n');

  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text }]
  };
}
```
